description: This file defines structures, macros, and function prototypes for the Background Noise Source Characteristic Detector (SCD) used in speech codec processing, specifically for AMR speech codec background noise detection.

methods.name: Bgn_scd_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the state memory for background noise detection.

methods.name: Bgn_scd_reset
methods.description: Resets the state memory of the background noise detector.

methods.name: Bgn_scd_exit
methods.description: Frees the memory used for the background noise detector state.

methods.name: Bgn_scd
methods.description: Performs background noise characterization and detection based on speech and energy history.
